title: Edge CloudFront option for custom domains (Amplify domain API throttled)
description: Turn /Users/home/Projects/edge-cloudfront/p-apyr-us.yaml (ACM + CloudFront in front of Amplify default domains, x-forwarded-host function, apex 301) into a Papyrus feature, as an option when create-domain-association is throttled. Note: CloudFront refuses aliases whose DNS still points at another distribution; remove stale records first. Run 2026-10-11 for p.apyr.us.
right_now_summary: Papyrus is adding a CloudFront fallback for custom domains when Amplify throttles domain creation.
